unit.title: Electricity
unit.blurb: Things that use electricity, staying safe with electricity, and making a simple circuit with a battery, wires and a bulb.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Name things that use electricity and know how to stay safe.

O2.t: Know that a complete circuit is needed to light a bulb.

p: **Electricity** makes many things work: lights, TVs, fridges and computers. Some get it from the **mains** (a plug in the wall) and some from a **battery**.
Never put anything into a plug socket and never touch plugs with wet hands. Mains electricity can badly hurt you.

p: A **circuit** is a loop. Electricity flows from the **battery**, along a **wire**, through the **bulb** and back to the battery. If there is a **gap**, the bulb does not light.
Put your finger on the battery and follow the wires. If you get back to the battery without a gap, the circuit is complete.

q.prompt: Will the bulb light if there is a gap in the circuit?

options.fb: Electricity cannot jump across a gap.

q.prompt: Which part pushes electricity round the circuit?

options.fb: The bulb uses the electricity to make light.

req.reason: battery – pushes electricity round; switch – opens and closes a gap; wire – carries electricity.
